facts.fact: Lei n.º 20/17, promulgated on 9 August 2017 and in force on publication, amends articles 8, 20 and 52 of Lei n.º 4/09 on the legal regime of civil identification and issue of the national citizen identity card (an act of the National Assembly).
facts.system: Lei n.º 4/09 (Regime Jurídico da Identificação Civil e Emissão do Bilhete de Identidade de Cidadão Nacional), as amended by Lei n.º 20/17

facts.fact: The amended article 8 of Lei n.º 4/09 has the identity card carry a data-storage microprocessor holding the visible identifying data and non-visible items such as tax, social security, birth-record and voter numbers, so that the card can interact with public and private institutions.
